result.reason: The operative language supplies the preferred Vendor indemnity for third-party IP claims, legal violations, Vendor-caused unauthorized access or disclosure, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct; protects Customer and its Affiliates; includes customary procedures, IP exclusions, and remedies; and limits Customer’s indemnity to Customer-provided content and legal violations. It also sensibly supplies the Section 20.5 remedy already referenced in Section 9.3 without altering unrelated terms. Drafting is strong, though the margin comment inaccurately cites Sections 19.4 and 30.5 rather than the provided Section 19.5, and the settlement-consent provision lacks a customary reasonableness qualifier.
